entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of garbage you sent me. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm very sorry to hear that you're not happy with your order. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, fine. Hold on. It's VF-8675309. I expect a full refund, and I expect it now.

Thank you. Pulling that up now... I see the order is for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered three days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
The issue is that it's the wrong size! I ordered a Large and this thing is so ridiculously tight I can't even zip it up. What kind of company sells a jersey that's this far off? It's a joke!

I understand your frustration when an item doesn't fit as expected. Our Aero Race line is designed for a compression fit, but it certainly sounds like it's far too tight for you. It sounds like you'd like to start a return or exchange, is that right?

Don't you listen? I want my money back! I'm not playing games with an exchange. This is ridiculous. I want to speak to your manager. Now! I'm about to post a review about this experience on every cycling forum I can find.

I can definitely process a return for you, there's no need to speak with a manager. You are well within our 90-day return policy for apparel. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now for a full refund.
A full refund? You're sure? No hidden fees or shipping charges taken out?
That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method, with no deductions for shipping. Alternatively, we could do an exchange for a larger size at no cost. The choice is entirely yours.
Okay. Fine. Just send me the label for a refund. That's all I wanted in the first place.

Of course. I have just sent that email with the prepaid return label and instructions to the address on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
